ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, what role does algae play in the ecosystem?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an Antarctic food web diagram, with an algae icon labeled “Algae” at the bottom, organisms such as “Krill” above, and a legend in the lower right corner. The legend uses dots of different shades to indicate Carnivore, Herbivore, and Primary producer. The Algae icon is the darkest gray, corresponding to the Primary producer marker in the legend. Reasoning: According to the legend, the darkest marker indicates Primary producer, so the role of algae in this ecosystem is producer.
